news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax completed a constructive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis, reaching alignment on the planned NDA submission strategy, content and format. The company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Abivax with Overweight Rating, Raises Target Price to $180
news.summary: Morgan Stanley raised its 12-month price target on Abivax to $180 from $132 while reiterating an Overweight rating, citing growing confidence in obefazimod's Phase 3 ulcerative colitis data and the company's path to a US launch.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a Global Head of Marketing recruited from Amgen with prior Entyvio experience at Takeda, as it builds out infrastructure ahead of its planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential US launch.

news.headline: Abivax $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC that Abivax's newly closed $920 million raise extends cash runway into 2029, giving the company the option to build its own US commercial infrastructure for obefazimod rather than being pushed into an acquisition by a larger pharma company.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Raises Abivax Price Target to $175 on Ulcerative Colitis Data
news.summary: Piper Sandler raised its price target to $175 from $165 and kept an Overweight rating, lifting its projected 2035 US ulcerative colitis revenue for obefazimod to $4.2 billion from $3.7 billion after concluding the malignancy safety signal has been definitively resolved by the Phase 3 maintenance data.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an upsized public offering of 7.36 million ADSs at $125 each after underwriters fully exercised their option, raising roughly $920 million in gross proceeds (about $874 million net) earmarked to support potential US commercialization of obefazimod.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Abivax reaffirmed plans to submit its first New Drug Application to the FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026, following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the agency.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's half-year 2026 financial results release is scheduled per the company's investor relations financial calendar.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD topline data (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately to severely active Crohn's disease are expected in mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA decision on obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: Assuming a Q4 2026 NDA filing and standard FDA review timelines, a PDUFA action date would fall roughly a year later; no official FDA decision date has been set yet.

catalysts.label: Big-pharma takeover / partnership speculation
catalysts.detail: Abivax has repeatedly been named as a potential acquisition or partnership target for large pharma companies (AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly among those rumored), though the company has denied specific reports and now emphasizes a self-funded US launch path after its $920 million raise.

catalysts.label: Potential US commercial launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Contingent on FDA approval, Abivax is building out its US commercial organization (sales, marketing, market access) to support a potential launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis.

pulse: Abivax heads into its mid-September H1 2026 results with clear momentum but no major fresh newsflow since late July: the positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA (obefazimod for ulcerative colitis) keeps the company on track for a Q4 2026 NDA filing, and the closed $920 million offering has pushed cash runway into 2029, letting management pursue a self-funded US commercial launch rather than depend on a takeover. Wall Street sentiment remains firmly bullish, with Piper Sandler and Morgan Stanley both raising price targets in July (into the $175-180 range) on easing safety concerns and higher long-term revenue estimates, while a broad analyst consensus stays at Buy/Overweight/Strong Buy. Big-pharma acquisition speculation (AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly) continues to simmer in the background, and the market now awaits the H1 2026 earnings update on September 21 and further progress toward the year-end NDA submission.
